messages:
Maria Chen: I opened a PR consolidating rate limit + quota examples into a single migration guide for v2 metering. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
Sam Patel: Nice. Can you add a short section about burst allowances and how they interact with per-route caps? customers keep asking about that.
Maria Chen: Yep, plan to add a subheading. Thinking of an example showing header semantics: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Burst-Credits`.
Alex Gomez: From console side we renamed the panel from "Total usage" to "Token consumption" — need to update all screenshots + dashboard links.
Jen Park: Also note the header name changed in the telemetry proxy for older Dedicated installs. Recommend a 1-paragraph migration note: if you're on <v2.1 you'll see `x-old-quota`.
Kevin Liu: L10n: will need short labels for the new dashboard name. Can we keep the old phrase in parens for a month? e.g. "Token consumption (Total usage)" :thought_balloon:
Maria Chen: Good call. I'll add that as a temporary caption and leave a TODO to remove after 30 days.
Sam Patel: For the SDK snippet, include both Python sync and Go async examples. Keep token math simple — show how to compute cost per 1k tokens.
Maria Chen: Draft snippet:
```python
# Python example: compute token cost
tokens = 3200
cost_per_1k = 0.0025  # USD
cost = tokens / 1000 * cost_per_1k
print(f\"Estimated cost: ${cost:.4f}\")
```
Alex Gomez: Can we also add a short curl example showing the `X-Burst-Credits` header in the response? Ops wants a reproducible test.
Maria Chen: Adding a curl snippet and a small test command. Will ping when ready for review.
DocsBot: PR opened by Maria Chen — CI: docs-build (staging) passed ✅ — Preview: https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.ai
Jen Park: QA checklist suggestion: update dashboard links, replace screenshot images, add migration note, verify snippet output, and add a changelog entry.
Kevin Liu: I'll take screenshots and l10n keys, tagging i18n team.
Sam Patel: I'll review the PR tomorrow morning, focus on accuracy of headers and examples.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Targeting merge by EOD Fri. I'll drop a follow-up in #announcements when merged. :rocket:
